title: Gemini 3 Flash takes the default slot
summary:
Gemini 3 Flash became the default, audio and chat requests got compatibility fixes, and Enter’s key list became easier to read.

`gemini` and `gemini-search` now route to Gemini 3 Flash Preview, while the new `gemini-fast` name provides Gemini 2.5 Flash Lite. A follow-up changed the Vertex AI region to resolve 404s for the Gemini 3 Flash aliases.

`openai-audio` now accepts all 13 voices shown in its model listing. Temperature handling also checks the resolved model, preventing 400 errors when an alias such as `openai-fast` routes to a model that requires temperature 1.

Enter’s key list gained Last Used and Expires columns, with warnings for keys nearing expiration. A separate tier and frontend refactor was merged, then reverted after it was associated with API docs and chat completion failures; its tier changes are not part of the day’s final result.
